title: Remak bundle size, structure, and function are regulated by the Schwann cell basal lamina
title_zh: 瑞马克束的尺寸、结构与功能受施旺细胞基底膜调控
abstract: Remak bundles are groups of small-diameter unmyelinated nociceptive axons ensheathed by Schwann cells (SCs). Whereas the development and maturation of myelinating SCs have been extensively studied, the formation of Remak bundles remains poorly understood. By preventing the secretion of type IV collagen from SCs, we observe normal myelin but abnormal Remak bundles. There is a decrease in Remak bundle density, an increase in bundle size, improperly ensheathed axons, and a decrease in mechanosensitivity. While Remak bundle formation appears to be independent of integrin signaling, the loss of type IV collagen leads to a decrease in postnatal SC proliferation. Inducing the emergence of supernumerary SCs rescues Remak bundle architecture and mechanosensitivity. Taken together, our results demonstrate that SC-secreted basal lamina critically regulates Remak SC number, bundle size, and structure. Our findings provide insight into the functional role of Remak bundles and highlight their potential involvement in peripheral neuropathies and neuropathic pain.
abstract_zh: 瑞马克束是由施旺细胞（SCs）包裹的小直径无髓鞘痛觉轴突组成的群体。虽然髓鞘形成的施旺细胞的发育与成熟已被广泛研究，但瑞马克束的形成仍不清楚。通过阻止施旺细胞分泌IV型胶原，我们观察到髓鞘正常但瑞马克束异常。瑞马克束密度下降、束体尺寸增大、轴突包裹不当以及机械敏感性降低。虽然瑞马克束的形成似乎与整合素信号无关，但IV型胶原缺失导致出生后施旺细胞增殖减少。诱导多余施旺细胞的出现可恢复瑞马克束的结构与机械敏感性。综上所述，我们的结果表明施旺细胞分泌的基底膜对瑞马克施旺细胞数量、束体尺寸和结构具有关键调控作用。我们的发现为瑞马克束的功能作用提供了见解，并突出了其在外周神经病变和神经性疼痛中的潜在作用。
